prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single character turnaround sprite sheet for a gothic RPG, compatible with 32-bit Castlevania and Ragnarok Online inspired pixel art. Original adult male hero: nerdy British roadman, medium-brown skin, large glasses, expressive face, messy voluminous high and wide afro with loose irregular curls, dramatically splayed silhouette, almost cartoonishly tall but not a direct copy of any existing character. Contemporary streetwear: dark hooded jacket, crossbody bag, tapered trousers and trainers, plus subtle scholarly details such as a pocket notebook. Exactly eight separate full-body idle sprites of this SAME character, each once, on a regular 4-column by 2-row grid: front, front-left, left profile, back-left, back, back-right, right profile, front-right. Equal apparent height, consistent hair silhouette, glasses, clothing, proportions and baseline, evenly spaced with generous margins, no overlap, no cropped feet or hair. Deliberate pixel clusters, dark outlines, restrained Gothic palette, no scene, no borders, no lettering or labels, no extra characters. Transparent background.
